entry.title: Rumor: vivo is developing a wide-screen phone for a 2027 launch
entry.summary: vivo is working on a wide-screen phone aimed at a 2027 launch, following similar reports about other Android brands.

entry.title: Likely: Lucid teases a cheaper Cosmos EV aimed under $50,000
entry.summary: Lucid is preparing a cheaper Cosmos model positioned under $50,000, shown in a new teaser video and images.

entry.title: Rumor: Honor is developing a Robot Phone 2 for a 2027 launch
entry.summary: Honor is working on a second-generation Robot Phone that could launch in 2027.

entry.title: Confirmed: Tesla winds down Cybertruck production around mid-2027 to free Giga Texas for Cybercab
entry.summary: Tesla will wind down Cybertruck production at Gigafactory Texas around the middle of 2027 to make room for more Cybercab production.

entry.title: Likely: Tesla's SI6 inference chip targets ~80x HW4 compute around 2029-2030, with a chiplet Dojo D3 for training
entry.summary: Tesla's refreshed accelerator roadmap renames AI chips to SI (Super Intelligence); SI6 aims for about 80x HW4/SI4 compute and 9x memory around 2029-2030, while Dojo D3 becomes a chiplet design with stacked HBM aimed at scalable and space-ready training.

entry.title: Confirmed: Apple launches OLED touchscreen MacBook Pros and an M6 lineup at its Oct 28 launch
entry.summary: At its Oct 28 launch Apple will announce OLED touchscreen 14- and 16-inch MacBook Pros (M5 Pro/Max), an OLED iPad mini, a 14-inch M6 MacBook Pro and an M6 iMac, with sales from Nov 6.

entry.title: Confirmed: Honor 700 series launches in November with three models and a rear screen on every model
entry.summary: Honor will launch three Honor 700 models in China in November; every model has a built-in rear display, and the 700 Pro adds a stronger camera setup around a roughly 9,000mAh battery class.

entry.title: Rumor: BYD's Yangwang Altior luxury sedan debuts in the UAE in early November with solid-state batteries
entry.summary: BYD will unveil its 5.5-meter Yangwang Altior executive sedan in Dubai around Nov 5, as the first car with BYD's solid-state batteries, priced around 2 million yuan.

entry.title: Shaky: vivo X500 Ultra uses the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6, a huge battery and a bigger 200MP telephoto
entry.summary: The vivo X500 Ultra launches in China around March-April 2027 with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6, a flat 6.85-inch BOE LTPO screen, an ultrasonic fingerprint sensor, a 7,000-8,000mAh battery, a 50MP Sony LYT910 35mm main camera and a 200MP 1/1.2-inch telephoto.

entry.title: Likely: Samsung readies a Galaxy Fit 4 that looks just like the Fit 3
entry.summary: Samsung will launch a Galaxy Fit 4 (SM-R391) fitness band with a near-identical design to the Fit 3, in black, white and light blue, at a similar low price.

entry.title: Rumor: Oppo Find X10 Ultra gets a LOFIC 200MP main camera, two periscopes and a 100MP selfie camera
entry.summary: The Find X10 Ultra will have a 200MP 1/1.12-inch main camera with LOFIC, a 200MP periscope, a 50MP 10x periscope and a 100MP square-sensor selfie camera.

entry.title: Debunked: Motorola Signature 27 costs about €1,595 in Europe, and a Razr Flex 27 about €1,511
entry.summary: The Motorola Signature 27 (12GB/512GB) will cost €1,594.90 in Europe, up nearly 60% from the first Signature's €999, and the unannounced Razr Flex 27 (12GB/256GB) will cost €1,510.90.

entry.title: Likely: The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel is more than two years away
entry.summary: Bethesda's newly named The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel will not ship for more than two years.

entry.title: Likely: Apple's HomeView will run third-party AI chatbots like ChatGPT and Claude
entry.summary: Apple's HomeView hub will allow third-party conversational AI apps such as ChatGPT and Claude.

entry.title: Rumor: Apple asks suppliers for 16 million MacBook Neo laptops in 2027, double this year
entry.summary: Apple has asked suppliers to build 16 million MacBook Neo laptops in 2027, about twice the volume expected for 2026.

entry.title: Rumor: Huawei's new sub-brand is called Osta and debuts with the flagship-level Osta O1 and wide-screen O1 Pro
entry.summary: Huawei's upcoming sub-brand, reported in Chinese as Xingmang, will be called Osta in English and launch with two flagship-level phones: the Osta O1 with a quad-curved screen and the Osta O1 Pro with a 6.39-inch 1.5K wide-aspect flat screen and up to 16GB/1TB.

entry.title: Rumor: Huawei Mate 80 Air launches in December
entry.summary: Huawei will launch the Mate 80 Air thin phone next month, with the MatePad Mini 2 arriving separately, possibly also in December.

entry.title: Rumor: Redmi Turbo 6 Max packs an 11,000mAh battery
entry.summary: The Redmi Turbo 6 Max will have an 11,000mAh (40.72Wh) battery, a 7-inch 2K 185Hz OLED and a Dimensity 9500s chip.

entry.title: Likely: Galaxy S27 family has four models, including a compact S27 Pro
entry.summary: Samsung will release the Galaxy S27, S27+, S27 Pro and S27 Ultra.

entry.title: Shaky: Galaxy S27 Ultra may switch to Exynos 2700 because Snapdragon overheats
entry.summary: Samsung found the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 overheating in S27 Ultra testing and may use its own Exynos 2700 chip if Qualcomm doesn't fix it by mid-October.

entry.title: Confirmed: Apple Intelligence fully launches in China with iOS 27.3 in December
entry.summary: After an October beta, Apple will roll out Apple Intelligence in China with iOS 27.3 in December, without the new Siri, Image Playground or the newer Genmoji.

entry.title: Rumor: NVIDIA swaps the RTX 5080 to 24GB in Q1 2027
entry.summary: NVIDIA will release an RTX 5080 with 24GB of GDDR7 in early 2027, gradually replacing the 16GB model.

entry.title: Shaky: Galaxy S27 and S27+ start with just 8GB of RAM
entry.summary: Because of soaring memory prices, Samsung will sell 8GB/256GB versions of the Galaxy S27 and S27+ alongside 12GB/512GB models, while the S27 Pro and Ultra start at 12GB.

entry.title: Confirmed: Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon, the successor to Argon, within weeks
entry.summary: Google's next Gemini 4 checkpoint, Carbon, is in partner early access and will be released publicly soon.

entry.title: Rumor: iPhone 18e keeps a 60Hz screen but gets the A20 and possibly a 24MP selfie camera
entry.summary: The iPhone 18e will have a 6.12-inch 60Hz LTPS OLED screen, the 2nm A20 chip, a single 48MP rear camera and maybe a 24MP front camera.

entry.title: Rumor: Second-generation touchscreen MacBook Pros get M7 Pro/Max in 2027, and non-touch Pro models are dropped
entry.summary: Apple will ship second-generation OLED touchscreen MacBook Pros with M7 Pro and M7 Max chips next year and then stop selling the non-touch M5 Pro/Max models, keeping only an entry 14-inch MacBook Pro that moves to M7 and the new thinner design without touch.

entry.title: Likely: Galaxy S27 Pro uses the regular Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6, not the Ultra's Extreme chip
entry.summary: In Europe, the Galaxy S27 and S27+ use the Exynos 2700, the S27 Pro uses the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 (SM8950), and only the S27 Ultra gets the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6, all with 12GB of RAM and 256GB of storage.

entry.title: Rumor: Standard iPhone 18 gets a bigger battery and a higher price
entry.summary: The standard iPhone 18 will have a larger battery than the iPhone 17's 3,692 mAh, keep a 6.3-inch 120Hz OLED with Dynamic Island, use the 2nm A20 and dual 48MP cameras, and may cost more.

entry.title: Rumor: Ubisoft bids to buy Arkane Lyon from Xbox
entry.summary: Ubisoft and at least two other game companies have made offers to buy Arkane Lyon, the studio making Marvel's Blade, and Xbox has also considered a management buyout.

entry.title: Rumor: Honor is testing a 14,000-15,000mAh phone battery for a week of use
entry.summary: Honor has a 14,000-15,000mAh high-density phone battery in trial production, aimed at a phone that lasts about a week per charge without being unusually thick or heavy.
